answer: Use one shared task/result/isolation/closeout contract for both execution modes, with one post-reconciliation project packet.

question: How is Codex work assigned and retained?
rationale: One accountable session owns each assigned deliverable. Explicit finite batches may use bounded native delegation; independent tasks may instead use separate roots and isolated writing copies. Workers retain scoped results/handoffs. A final reconciler consumes the selected results, integrates authorized writing work, reconciles read-only findings and validates the target; a single fully reconciled root performs this itself. Only final reconciliation publishes the project next-round packet. NEXT_ROUND.md is a derived manual ChatGPT planning interface, while structured records remain canonical. The human chooses priorities; no automatic project selection, acceptance or backlog execution.
revisit: Concrete usability, safety or measured coordination evidence warrants a bounded change.
